approach_reason: Original mesh.glb (61517 verts, TripoSR topology) is unsuitable for facial shape keys. Separate low-poly facial meshes added and skinned to head bone.

facial_geometry_added.name: FaceMouth
facial_geometry_added.description: Low-poly lip ring: 8-vert outer lip ring + 8-vert inner ring + center vertex. Positioned at lower face (Z~0.198, Y~0.083 in armature local space). 17 vertices, 16 faces.

facial_geometry_added.name: FaceEyes
facial_geometry_added.description: Two eye arc panels (left+right combined mesh). Each eye: 8-vert upper arc + 8-vert lower arc. Positioned at upper face (Z~0.240, Y~0.093 in armature local space). 32 vertices, 14 faces.

shape_key_tests.method: Set shape key value=1.0, compare every vertex against Basis coords, record max displacement. Pass threshold: >1mm.

head_follow_test.method: Pose head bone +30° X rotation, use depsgraph evaluated_get() to read world-space vertex 0 position before and after. Measure displacement.

glb_verification.method: Re-import bunny_character_lipsync.glb in clean Blender process, run 35 automated checks
checks_verified: body mesh has armature modifier + 18 vertex groups
All 9 mouth shape keys present (jawOpen, mouthClose, mouthSmile, mouthPucker, viseme_A, viseme_E, viseme_I, viseme_O, viseme_U)
All 9 mouth shape keys produce real deformation (12-28mm range)
Both eye shape keys present (blink.L, blink.R)
Both eye shape keys produce real deformation (23.4mm)
FaceMouth skinned to head bone (armature_mod + head vertex group)
FaceEyes skinned to head bone (armature_mod + head vertex group)

usage_guide.access_mouth_controls: morphTargetInfluences on FaceMouth mesh (GLTF morph targets)
usage_guide.access_eye_controls: morphTargetInfluences on FaceEyes mesh (GLTF morph targets)
usage_guide.note: Shape keys are exported as GLTF morph targets (index 0 = first non-Basis key). Basis key is not included in morph targets.
